2608.19043.title: Bernstein-Vazirani Networks: Quantum Machine Learning by Interference
2608.19043.paper_summary: We introduce Bernstein-Vazirani Networks (BVNs), a non-variational quantum machine learning framework that leverages quantum interference for supervised learning, demonstrated on vision and representation learning tasks. In their standard form, BVNs follow the principle of quantum Fourier sampling: labelled data are placed in superposition and interfered in the Fourier basis to extract globally informative features. We then define generalised BVNs that enable interference in problem-adapted bases, yielding more expressive models under the same measurement budget as in the standard setting. BVNs achieve universal function approximation through (over)complete interference bases, while training of BVNs is gradient-free. Experiments on synthetic and real-world classification tasks, as well as implicit image representation, show strong generalisation capabilities and competitive performance with classical and quantum baselines.
2608.19043.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹伯恩斯坦-瓦茲拉尼網絡（BVNs），這是一種非變分量子機器學習框架，利用量子干涉進行監督學習，並在視覺和表示學習任務中進行了演示。在其標準形式中，BVNs 遵循量子傅立葉抽樣的原則：標記數據被置於疊加態中，並在傅立葉基底中進行干涉，以提取全局信息特徵。我們接著定義了廣義 BVNs，使得在問題適應的基底中進行干涉，從而在與標準設置相同的測量預算下產生更具表達力的模型。BVNs 通過（過）完整的干涉基底實現通用函數近似，而 BVNs 的訓練是無梯度的。在合成和現實世界的分類任務以及隱式圖像表示上的實驗顯示出強大的泛化能力，並與經典和量子基準相比具有競爭力的性能。
